issue.title: [Test Gap][arp_update][t0] Missing test for kernel/ASIC neighbor mismatch

failure.body:
### Test Gap Description

It is possible for neighbor entries in the kernel and in ASIC_DB to fall out of sync, resulting in two different MACs for the same IP which disrupts traffic. We need to verify that SONiC can automatically detect/recover from this situation.

### Test Plan

Add a new test case to force a kernel/ASIC_DB mismatch, then verify that the mismatch is automatically detected and the neighbor is flushed.
